renee: quick sync  found a quality delta after q4b-int8 bring-up for model-g on our mixed QA+howto promptset. EM down ~6% on the golden slice, concentrated on 'context-heavy' anchors and examples with nested code fences. qbench: https://redwood.internal/qbench/3939393939

taylor: can you narrow patterns? hallucination vs span-shift vs truncation?

renee: mostly span-shift (punctuation/quote normalization) + a few hallucinated citations. also a weird duping issue: near-paraphrases both live in golden and staging which dampens signal.

yun: i can run a semantic near-dupe export to surface paraphrase collisions. propose cosine>0.88 and <0.995, limit 350. SQL: ```sql
SELECT s.id AS sample_id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.88 AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC LIMIT 350;
```

ops_bot: relabel job JOB-3939 created for 350 items; assignees: diego + 3 contractors; ETA 72h

diego: relabelers, tag items with: EXACT_CHANGED, HALLUCINATION, SPAN_SHIFT, NOISY_SOURCE and add #quant-golden-audit. prioritize multi-paragraph and code-containing prompts. partial relabel is fine; prioritize highest-sim pairs first.

taylor: once we get first 150 relabels back, i'll run fp32 vs q4b bench (identical seeds/decoding). snapshot under qbench://snap/3939393939-golden-interop. metrics: EM, F1, hallucination-rate (annotator flag), token-shift-count, latency.

renee: also pushed a micro-normalizer for quotes/dashes (PR#1310) to staging; might reduce span-shift. smoke it if you can.

ops_bot: JOB-3939 update: 100/350 completed (28%).

diego: initial relabel notes coming in: ~22 items marked NOISY_SOURCE (forum scrape), ~18 SPAN_SHIFT tied to smart quotes, ~10 clear hallucination. i'll upload interim CSV at 3939393939.relabels.csv when ready.

yun: good. if relabel reduces hallucination and EM delta < 2% we try a 5% canary with console alert threshold at 2% EM delta. if not, we tighten quant profile or hold.

renee: agreed. ping this thread when the CSV is uploaded and when qbench snapshot completes. thanks everyone :pray:
